facts.text: Buck cooks for an army, then makes the kids eat it all week
facts.why: No lasagne scene turns up. What the film shows is Buck cooking big, serving gigantic pancakes for Miles's birthday, so the note should lean on that.
facts.fix: Buck cooks big, like those gigantic birthday pancakes

vibe.verdict: Cosy diner look with a John Candy still, but it is built for pie when the film is about pancakes and a few scenes.
